sources.entry: iGlance - macOS System Monitor (cpu, memory, network, fan and battery) for the Status Bar.

summary.one_liner: iGlance is a small macOS menu bar system monitor showing CPU, temperature, memory, network, fan speed and battery stats, though the project is no longer under active development.
summary.what_it_does: The app displays current Mac stats in the menu bar. It can show CPU utilization as a graph and read CPU temperature. It also monitors memory usage, network usage and fan speed. Users can set low and/or high battery notification thresholds. The interface adjusts to light and dark mode. The README says it is built to be customizable, and settings can be imported and exported according to the roadmap.
use_cases: monitor cpu usage from the menu bar
check mac temperature and fan speed
track memory and network usage on a mac
get low or high battery alerts on a mac
keep system stats visible while working
how_to_run: Download iGlance.dmg from the releases page and move the app into the Applications folder
Or install with Homebrew: brew install --cask iglance
notable: Menu bar graphs for CPU utilization
Reads CPU temperature and fan speed
caveats: The README says the project is no longer under active development
Unofficial lookalike app iStats X in the App Store shows random values, not real readings, according to the README
Roadmap items for disk I/O and drag-and-drop menu arrangement are unfinished
